description: Catalogue of the RAG corpus. Every document listed here is ingested. Short single-topic cards (about 1.5-3k characters) with typed metadata. document_id is the key used by retriever metadata, citations and eval/gold_set.json.

categories.match_case: a recent final (2022-2026): how the winner won, with numbers
categories.game_situation: an in-game or preparation problem: options, risks, real cases
categories.coach_profile: one file per coach, merging every source that describes that coach
categories.thesis_note: a concept from the theses, not tied to a match moment

fields.origin_type: derived = written by the project from the cited sources
fields.reliability: project_synthesis_cited = every fact cites a source with page; sections marked 'interpretazione del progetto' are the project's reading
fields.sources: upstream documents (thesis + pages, Wikipedia revision, FIFA/StatsBomb data) or other card ids

upstream_not_ingested.references/wikipedia/: CC BY-SA 4.0 extracts with revision ids
